info.title: Pagesnap API
info.description: Turn public HTTP(S) URLs into Markdown, structured data, images, PDFs, crawls, diffs, and monitors. Anonymous, API-key, agent-protocol, and x402 payment surfaces are described from the same runtime contract.
info.x-guidance: For keyless USDC requests, call an /x402/v1 route once without payment, decode PAYMENT-REQUIRED, then retry the same request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

apiQuery.name: key
apiQuery.description: Compatibility only; headers avoid key leakage in URLs.

x402.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
x402.description: x402 v2 exact EIP-3009 USDC authorization on Base; X-PAYMENT is a legacy alias.

rawBytes.description: Fetched or rendered source bytes before extraction.

noTextLayer.description: True when a PDF contains no extractable text layer; Pagesnap does not pretend OCR occurred.

plan_expires_at.description: Unix milliseconds; normally seven days after creation for a trial.

key_prefix.description: Never send a complete API key.

Forbidden.description: Disabled key, plan restriction, or blocked target.

Conflict.description: Current resource state conflicts with the request.

TooLarge.description: Request or stored result is too large.

Unprocessable.description: Input is understood but unsupported or cannot be processed.

RateLimited.description: Caller, quota, concurrency, or target-host limit reached.

Unavailable.description: Capacity, facilitator, billing, or engine temporarily unavailable.
